jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise AI
jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Applied AI Engineer at GitLab, you'll build and deploy AI-powered solutions for GitLab's own teams. You'll join Enterprise AI in the CIO organization, reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise AI. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write production code and partner with senior engineers and internal business stakeholders to solve problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Your focus is GitLab's internal operations, rather than customer implementations or development of the GitLab product.

Building fast matters, and we want engineers who ship. But speed without understanding the problem leads to the wrong solution shipped quickly. You'll partner with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand the real problem first: how work moves across teams, where the real constraint lives, and whether AI is the right intervention. From there, you'll take ownership of the build and deployment, combining strong engineering skills with curiosity about the business systems you're improving.

Your initial focus will span GitLab's own Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams, where you'll embed AI solutions into the systems and workflows they use every day. This role offers the opportunity to grow as an engineer while shaping how GitLab team members work, in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.

What you'll do

  • Contribute to problem diagnosis alongside the team. Engage with stakeholders to understand the real constraint before reaching for a solution, and be willing to flag when AI isn't the right answer.
  • Own the build and deployment of AI solutions, from technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration. Partner with senior engineers on discovery and scoping.
  • Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.
  • Build solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Track flow, adoption, and ROI metrics defined for the work.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into GitLab's internal business systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.
  • Be Customer Zero: use GitLab's AI products in our own internal workflows, assess how they perform in practice, and share feedback with R&D to help improve them.
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions. Ask good questions, surface assumptions, and align with the team on outcomes before jumping to implementation.
  • Track success against defined business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.
  • Contribute to documentation and reusable patterns that help the team scale its impact.

What you'll bring

  • A Technologist at Heart - Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energized by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.

Competent, Confident Coding Skills - You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer — AI Architecture Research
jobs.jd: About the Role We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer focused on AI architecture research to help design, prototype, and validate next-generation model architectures. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production — turning new ideas into scalable, real-world systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys questioning architectural assumptions , experimenting with novel model designs, and pushing beyond standard Transformer-style approaches. What You’ll Work On Research and develop new neural network architectures (e.g. alternatives or extensions to Transformers, recurrent / hybrid models, long-context systems) Design and run architecture-level experiments (scaling laws, memory mechanisms, compute trade-offs) Prototype models end-to-end — from research code to training-ready implementations Collaborate with inference and systems engineers to ensure architectures are deployable and efficient Analyze model behavior, failure modes, and inductive biases Read, reproduce, and extend cutting-edge research papers Contribute to internal research notes, benchmarks, and open-source efforts (where applicable) What We’re Looking For Strong background in machine learning fundamentals and deep learning Hands-on experience implementing model architectures from scratch Solid understanding of: Attention mechanisms, RNNs, state-space models, or hybrid architectures Training dynamics, scaling behavior, and optimization Memory, latency, and compute constraints at the model level Comfortable working in PyTorch or JAX Ability to move fluidly between theory, experimentation, and engineering Clear communicator who can explain architectural trade-offs Nice to Have Experience with non-Transformer architectures (RNN variants, SSMs, long-context models) Background in research-driven startups or open-source ML projects Experience with large-scale training or custom training loops Publications, preprints, or notable research contributions Familiarity with inference optimization and deployment constraints Why Join Work on core model architecture , not just fine-tuning Direct influence on the technical direction of a Series-A company Small, high-caliber team with fast feedback loops Opportunity to ship research into production Competitive compensation + meaningful equity Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer
jobs.jd: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival. We build factories that learn. We sell tangible parts, not software: every part we make produces data on design, cost, process and quality. Our bet is that a factory which learns from that data makes each next part faster, better and with fewer people, and that what one factory learns, every new factory applies. The Role You own the learn and apply steps of our knowledge loop: you say what data the key bet needs and turn it into decisions that engineers and operators use every week. Concretely, you will: Identify the key bet: the decision in our factory, from quoting to quality, where learning from data pays off most Define, with our software engineers, what data we capture from day one Build the first learning-factory MVP yourself and put it in front of engineers and operators within weeks Decide what to build, what to buy and when a model is good enough to trust Show the company and our investors, with numbers, that the factory is learning Grow into the AI Lead role once your MVPs are proven What We're Looking For Several years shipping ML or LLM systems that real users depended on Stack: Strong Python, SQL and data engineering; comfortable from raw data to deployed tool Experience starting from zero data: you have designed what to capture and then built a tool on it Pragmatism: you use whatever method works, from a rule to an agent, judged by what helps the operator in front of you Curiosity for the physical world: you want to stand next to the machine and understand the operator's decision Clear writing and the ability to explain results and their limits Bonus: manufacturing, additive, CNC, CAD or geometry data; early-stage startup experience Language: English. German is a plus for shop-floor conversations. On-site: Ability to work in person at Zurich, Switzerland, with regular time on the shop floor at Factory ONE in Munich, Germany. What we're not looking for Researchers without a user: every model you build here has a factory user, or it is dropped Someone who needs clean data, a platform and a team before they can ship Someone who wants to manage first and build later: the lead role is earned by proven MVPs Generic ERP, MES or QMS feature work, or machine interaction: other teams own these What we offer Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the free world. What your systems learn in Factory ONE, every next factory applies. The Environment: A real factory as your lab, with direct access to the people who run it, and ownership of the core of SAEKI's value proposition from day one. The Team: A small, generalist Manufacturing Intelligence team that ships, reporting to the VP of Manufacturing Intelligence. Compensation: Competitive salary + equity. Location: Zurich HQ Apply Resume: Focus on systems you shipped that real users relied on, and what happened to them after launch. Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first? You’ll partner closely with product managers, UX designers, data scientists, and backend engineers to ship AI-driven features that enhance member engagement, self-service, and satisfaction. This is an applied engineering role focused on building production LLM applications—RAG pipelines, agentic and tool-using workflows, and inference services—rather than foundational model research. You don’t need to match every requirement. If you’ve shipped real LLM features in production and are excited by this work, we’d like to hear from you! Build frameworks for new client data, demographics, and expression rules. Document runbooks and validate datasets and access-control rules. Observability & Monitoring Instrument tracing and monitoring (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor) for model performance, cost, and safety. Continuous Improvement Run A/B testing and analytics to measure impact on member satisfaction and portal KPIs. Identify automation opportunities across the software-development lifecycle. What You Bring: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years in software or ML engineering, with 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping LLM/generative-AI applications in production.* Bilingual in both French and English, oral and written. Demonstrated depth of applied GenAI work (shipped RAG systems, chatbots, agents, or inference services). Strong hands-on experience with the core stack: Node.js/Express (REST APIs, async patterns); LLM/RAG (Azure OpenAI & OpenAI SDKs, prompt design, tool-use/function calling, token management); vector search (Azure AI Search or Pinecone); and LLM evaluation (eval sets, automated scoring, regression checks). Strong analytical mindset, clear communication, a collaborative attitude, and the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Alexa AI - ML Engineering
jobs.jd: Alexa Proactive, now powered by Alexa+, brings customers personalized, proactive content, suggestions and actions across Alexa devices and surfaces: news, sports, recipes, music, shopping deals and tips to discover new features. Behind these experiences are recommendation and ranking systems that anticipate what customers need and surface the right content, suggestions, or actions at the right moment, through the right channel. Deciding what to show, to whom, when, and through which channel, for millions of customers, is a large-scale recommendation and ranking problem, and much of its science is still ahead of us. We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join ML Engineering (MLE) India in Bengaluru, part of the Personalization and Delivery Engineering (PDE) org in Alexa AI, and build the recommendation and ranking systems behind Alexa+ proactive experiences. You will be part of Proactive Science, a global science team across time zones, and set the scientific direction for your area: content retrieval and relevance, ranking and re-ranking, how the full page is composed, and how the system learns from customer feedback. You will work closely with Proactive Science partners and with the software and data engineers who run these systems in production. We value scientists who can move fast: iterate on algorithms quickly, validate ideas through rigorous online experiments, and turn them into measurable customer and business impact. As a senior scientist, you will frame ambiguous problems on your own, make sound trade-offs between model quality, latency and cost, and deliver end-to-end solutions to production with limited guidance. You will also mentor scientists and engineers, and influence engineering, product, and science partners across teams. Key job responsibilities - Science roadmap: Own the science roadmap for proactive recommendation and ranking. Turn customer and business goals into clear ML problems, plans and metrics. - Proactive recommendation and ranking: Design and scale multi-stage recommendation systems (candidate generation, relevance filtering, ranking, re-ranking, and delivery policy) that decide what to surface, to whom, when, and through which channel, for millions of customers across Alexa devices and surfaces. - Personalization: Move ranking from popularity to deep personalization, using customer interests, engagement history, context (time of day, device) and content understanding. Apply two-tower retrieval, cross-encoders, learning-to-rank, CTR/CVR prediction, and sequential and multi-task recommendation models. - Whole-page optimization: Optimize the whole page, not only the ranked list: slot rules, diversity, share of voice and backup content. - Objective design and alignment: Build multi-objective ranking and optimization frameworks that align model objectives with business goals and customer experience metrics, with guardrails against fatigue, dismissals and repeated content. - Rapid iteration to impact: Drive fast experimentation cycles from hypothesis to offline evaluation, online A/B testing, and launch. Continuously improve models based on customer feedback and online results. - Explore and exploit: Bring explore and exploit into the system through contextual bandits, counterfactual and off-policy evaluation. - ML foundations: Partner with software and data engineers to build a feature store shared by training and inference, feature data-quality checks, automated retraining with evaluation gates, and model performance dashboards (CTR, NDCG and business metrics). - Content understanding and generation: Use LLMs and embeddings to strengthen content understanding, topic tagging and representations for ranking, and contribute to the generation of proactive content. - Scientific rigor: Own the full science lifecycle with sound experiment design, counterfactual evaluation, and production accountability. Ship models within strict latency and cost budgets, with safe fallbacks (for example distillation and efficient inference). - Leadership: Mentor scientists and engineers, run science and design reviews, write clear documents for senior leaders, raise the hiring bar, and build reusable science components across teams. A day in the life A DAY IN THE LIFE No two days look the same, because many of the hardest problems are still open. You might start the morning with A/B results for a personalized re-ranker: clicks went up, but so did dismissals. You decide how to balance the two before you dial it up. Next, you take on a cold-start problem: a new content provider has no engagement history, so how should it earn a slot without hurting the page? With Proactive Science partners across time zones, you shape next half's roadmap: move from popularity ranking to deep personalization, replace fixed slot rules with a learned whole-page policy, add explore and exploit, and make retraining automatic. With software and data engineers, you work out how a larger model fits a tight latency budget, and what safe fallback serves when it times out. You end the day writing a short proposal that turns one open question into a plan the team can build. About the team ML Engineering (MLE) India, part of Personalization and Delivery Engineering (PDE) in Alexa AI, builds the personalization and proactive-intelligence systems that let Alexa anticipate what customers need before they ask. In Bengaluru, we own the AERO runtime, which selects and composes proactive content for Alexa devices, and CxT (Customer Experience Telemetry), which captures how customers see and engage with that content. Together with Proactive Science, our global science team, we turn this into better proactive experiences for customers. - Shape the science: you set the roadmap, pick the problems, and define how science and engineering work together on proactive experiences. - A direct path to customers: our team runs the system that serves your models, and our telemetry gives you the signals you learn from. jobs.title: Data Scientist & Researcher
jobs.jd: Your profile Data Scientist & Researcher Turba Labs · Heidelberg (Germany) or San Francisco Bay Area (USA) · On-site, hybrid or remote · Full-time · Candidates must live in Germany or the USA AI infrastructure is no longer uniform. Data centers now run mixed clusters of GPU generations, vendors and accelerators, and the software that schedules work on them was mostly built for uniform hardware. Turba Labs is building what replaces it. Two products. The Scheduler runs live on our clients' infrastructure and decides which workload runs on which GPU, and when. The Simulator answers a related question before a data center spends a cent: given a planned build-out, what is the best way to use it? Both are only as good as the science underneath. You are that science. What you will own The scheduling brain. Policies that place and sequence workloads across heterogeneous GPUs, from sharp heuristics to optimization to reinforcement learning, whichever one actually wins on real data. The Simulator's truth. Performance, cost and utilization models accurate enough that a data center bases a hardware purchase on them, and a running measure of how far they drift from what the Scheduler sees in production. The signal in live cluster data. Where capacity is lost, why, and what to test next. The research agenda. Decide which questions matter, kill the ones that don't, and take the survivors from hypothesis to something our engineers ship. The standard of proof. Evaluation rigorous enough that the team and our clients trust a result without rerunning it. Who you are You have solved a hard scheduling, resource allocation or optimization problem, and you can show what changed because of it. You build a model, then try to break it against reality. A result that has not survived real data does not count. You pick the simplest method that works, and the sophisticated one when it earns its place. You are fluent in Python and the modern ML stack, and at home in large, messy utilization and job data. You can explain a hard result to an engineer, a product lead and a data center operator without losing the truth. We do not screen on years or titles. We screen on the hardest thing you have worked on and how deeply you understood it. A plus Hands-on GPU or accelerator performance work, LLM training or inference workloads, or cluster schedulers such as Kubernetes or Slurm. You have built simulators, digital twins or performance models of real systems. Published or open-source work on scheduling, resource management or efficient AI. Why this This is infrastructure software that changes how AI compute gets used. What you prove here runs on real hardware in real data centers, with real money on the line, alongside the people building both products. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Mid-Market Enterprise
jobs.jd: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineeriIng teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As a Mid-Market Enterprise Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work as one of the early hires for a new segment within Applied AI Engineering, contributing real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in our SF or NYC office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Partner directly with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria. - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes. - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators. - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution. - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact. - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback. - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. You’ll thrive in this role if you: - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting. - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering—not only program or stakeholder management. - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment. - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives. - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments. - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. jobs.title: Werkstudent Agentic AI & Microsoft Copilot Studio (w/m/div.)
jobs.jd: Künstliche Intelligenz eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten, Geschäftsprozesse effizienter zu gestalten und Wissen intelligent zu nutzen. Im Rahmen unserer bereichsübergreifenden AI-Initiative entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Copilot Studio und Microsoft 365. Bei uns hast du die Gelegenheit, die Entwicklung intelligenter AI Agents aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam mit unserem Cross-Functional Team neue Anwendungsfälle von der Idee bis zum funktionsfähigen Prototyp umzusetzen. Während deiner Werkstudententätigkeit unterstützt du unser Team bei der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Optimierung intelligenter AI Agents mit Microsoft Copilot Studio. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir KI-gestützte Workflows und automatisieren Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von Microsoft Power Automate und Microsoft 365. Du wirkst bei der Integration von Large Language Models (LLMs), der Entwicklung geeigneter Prompts sowie dem Aufbau wissensbasierter Anwendungen mit. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du die Anbindung interner und externer Datenquellen, beispielsweise über SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, APIs und Custom Connectors. Du hilfst bei der Entwicklung und Erprobung von Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentenlogiken und automatisierten Entscheidungsprozessen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Cross-Functional Team und verschiedenen Fachbereichen analysierst du Anforderungen und setzt ausgewählte AI Use Cases technisch um. Nicht zuletzt unterstützt du uns beim Testen, Evaluieren und Dokumentieren der entwickelten Lösungen und wirkst am Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Entwicklungsstandards mit. Ausbildung: Studium im Bereich Informatik, Künstliche Intelligenz, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung. Erfahrungen und Know-how: Erste Kenntnisse in der Programmierung, idealerweise mit Python, sowie grundlegendes Verständnis von Large Language Models, generativer KI und modernen Softwaretechnologien. Technisches Interesse: Begeisterung für Agentic AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Microsoft 365 und die Entwicklung intelligenter Automatisierungslösungen. Erste praktische Erfahrungen sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Arbeitsweise & Vor-Ort-Präsenz: Du arbeitest strukturiert sowie selbstständig, bringst eigene Ideen ein und hast Freude daran, neue Technologien auszuprobieren. Da die enge Abstimmung im Team und die gemeinsame Arbeit an Systemen eine regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort an unserem Standort erfordert, ist die Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Büro vor Ort für diese Stelle gegeben. Begeisterung: Du interessierst dich für innovative KI-Anwendungen und möchtest aktiv daran mitwirken, neue Technologien in die Unternehmenspraxis zu übertragen. Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams! Wir bieten Fachkräften deutschlandweit verantwortungsvolle und vielfältige Angebote. Als Berater, Errichter und Dienstleister entwickeln und realisieren wir auf Basis modernster Technologien vernetzte Lösungen in der Gebäudesicherheit, Gebäudeautomation und Energieeffizienz. Täglich setzt sich unser Team von über 3.600 Mitarbeitenden an mehr als 50 Standorten in Deutschland mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und Fachkompetenz dafür ein, unsere Kunden zufrieden zu stellen und Gebäudelösungen für ein besseres Leben zu schaffen. jobs.title: Sr Worldwide Specialist - GenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Data & AI GTM
jobs.jd: Do you want to help define the future of Go to Market (GTM) for Amazon Bedrock? In this role, you will define, build, and deploy targeted strategies to accelerate customer adoption of Amazon Bedrock across industry verticals. You will engage with product managers to influence product direction and help customers tap into new markets using Amazon Bedrock alongside other AWS services. Amazon Bedrock hosts a number of foundation models — you will work directly with the model providers on joint GTM plans, joint customer engagements, external/internal evangelism, and demos and proof-of-concepts. Key job responsibilities You will define the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore lead cross-functional initiatives to expand existing markets, build scalable adoption programs, and identify new opportunities. Day to day this includes market sizing, partnering with counterparts across the globe to build an opportunity pipeline, working with customers to understand technical requirements, creating content to enable train field teams, driving industry thought leadership, working with product teams to define new features, and identifying partners. You will drive the GTM plan for scaling adoption of Amazon Bedrock, interact with customers directly to understand their business problems, and work with model providers and solutions architects to define and implement scalable GenAI solutions. You will also work closely with account teams and product teams to unblock and drive production implementations. The ideal candidate You bring a business and technology background that lets you lead engagements with customers across segments — from startups to multinational enterprises. You have domain expertise in Generative AI and key ML-powered use cases, and the technical depth to articulate the benefits of Amazon Bedrock and related GenAI services to data scientists and C-level business and technical executives. You understand GenAI market trends, ecosystem, and opportunities, and you are passionate about market development and evangelism. You partner well across AWS (product, solutions architecture, sales, marketing, professional services) and externally with customers and model providers. A day in the life You'll partner with AWS service teams, field solutions architecture, sales, and marketing — representing your team to executive management and working directly with AWS's top customers. You'll help companies and partners understand best practices for operating on AWS, and spot patterns and trends that can be applied broadly across an industry segment to accelerate innovation. About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. jobs.jd:

Decathlon Digital — Pôle People Data & AI

L'essentiel

  • 🎓 Contrat : stage de fin d'études (six mois)

  • 📅 Démarrage : premier trimestre 2027

  • 📍 Lieu : Paris 

  • 🎯 Niveau : Bac+5

Envie de bousculer le statu quo et de réinventer le quotidien technologique de 100 000 collaborateurs ?

Au sein de Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons un profil audacieux pour concevoir, prototyper et tester des alternatives radicales fondées sur l'IA générative et agentique. Ici, zéro maintenance : ton rôle consiste à challenger l'existant.

  • 🚀 Terrain d'expérimentation réel : tu audites les systèmes internes pour concevoir des solutions de rupture (agents autonomes, architectures RAG avancées, automatisation de pointe).

  • 🛠️ Stack technique moderne : GCP, Vertex AI, modèles de fondation récents et ressources dédiées pour tester tes prototypes à l'échelle.

 

Missions principales

  • 🔍 Audit & Discovery : repérer les zones de friction dans nos outils et identifier les cas d'usage où l'IA surpasse les solutions en place.

  • 🤖 Prototypage & R&D : coder et éprouver des architectures agentiques et des pipelines RAG avancés.

  • 📊 Évaluation & LLMOps : mesurer la performance de tes modèles selon des critères précis (latence, précision, coût, valeur métier).

  • 🔗 Protocoles d'interaction : tester l'intégration de standards récents (MCP, échanges Agent-to-Agent) avec notre écosystème Data et SIRH.

  • 🎙️ Restitution & impact : présenter tes démonstrations aux équipes produit et tech pour orienter les architectures de demain.

 

Profil recherché

  • 🎓 Formation : étudiant(e) en dernière année de cursus Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs ou master en IA, Data Science ou Informatique).

  • 💻 Technique : maîtrise de Python, aisance sur le cloud (GCP, Vertex AI) et culture solide en IA générative (LLM, embeddings, RAG, agents).

  • 💡 Savoir-être : profil « builder », esprit critique, curiosité technique et clarté à l'oral.

jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the team Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good. From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector. Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time. About the role As a Lead Machine Learning Engineer at Faculty, you will set the technical direction for complex AI/ML projects, ensuring models perform at scale and in production over time by balancing technical trade-offs and guiding team priorities. You will lead the delivery of large-scale AI-powered platforms in high-risk environments while defining project roadmaps across multiple complex workstreams. This is an ambitious, entrepreneurial leadership role where you will act as a trusted technical expert, defending your architectural rationale to senior stakeholders to ensure we deliver high-quality, high-value outputs. What you'll be doing: Designing, implementing, and maintaining reliable, scalable ML systems while justifying key architectural decisions for production environments. Driving the development of shared libraries and infrastructure for model deployment, lifecycle management, and CI/CD pipelines. Leading model integration with infrastructure by creating APIs and services that enable scalable AI functionality in applications. Overseeing the delivery of multiple complex workstreams and defining project problems in high-risk environments. Ensuring reliable model performance by defining testing frameworks and model versioning systems for senior engineers to implement. Managing and coaching multiple individuals, setting team-wide development goals to improve technical depth and client delivery. Executing proactive recommendations for adopting new technologies and AI frameworks to maintain Faculty's competitive market position. Who we're looking for: You are an expert at defining technical roadmaps and managing project priorities to deliver high-stakes outcomes within high-growth environments. You possess mastery of cloud-native ecosystems and orchestration tools like Kubernetes to automate complex model lifecycles and robust CI/CD pipelines. You have a proven ability to design large-scale, AI-powered platforms and provide the technical justification for critical architectural decisions in high-risk environments. You bring expert-level experience in operationalising models within frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch to solve complex, high-impact business challenges. You define the engineering standards and architecture patterns for agentic systems, ensuring teams build to a consistent, production-grade bar. You demonstrate an exceptional ability to align multi-disciplinary technical teams with broader business objectives and evolving customer needs. The Interview Process Talent Team Screen (30 minutes) Introduction to the Hiring Manager (30 minutes) Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes) System Design Interview (90 minutes) Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes) #LI-PRIO Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: About us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
jobs.jd:
Mission

De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.

Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.

Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.
  • Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.
  • Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.
  • Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.
  • Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.
  • Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.
  • Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.

 

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.
  2. Votre code est testé et maintenable.
  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.
  4. La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.
  5. Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.
  6. Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.
  • Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.
  • Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.
  • Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.
  • Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en produ

Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape. About the Role: We’re hiring a Senior AI Engineer to build and improve Osano AI, our intelligent privacy assistant. As part of the Osano AI team, you will take capabilities from first idea to production, with an emphasis on delivering capabilities that are reliable, measurable, and trustworthy. This role goes beyond wrapping APIs or building chat interfaces. We are looking for an engineer who has shipped LLM-powered systems that real users depend on. That means that you’ve dealt with hallucinations, latency, cost, evaluation, and tricky edge cases within agentic systems, and you know what it takes to keep these non-deterministic systems working after launch. You will often work on problems that aren’t well-defined. Success here depends on how you think, communicate, and work with others as much as on what you build. This position is ideal for someone who is highly technical, thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of 0→1 initiatives, wants to have an outsized impact, and believes responsible AI is non-negotiable. Balance quality, latency, reliability, and cost in production. Deploy data-driven methods to decide what to ship, how to fix it, and what to stop doing. Continuously refine deployed systems based on measurable outcomes. Collaborate and communicate Work closely with product managers, engineers, privacy experts, and other stakeholders to decide what to build, how to build it, and why. Write clear design documents and run effective technical discussions. Privacy-First Development Embed privacy-by-design principles across the AI stack. Ensure compliance, data sovereignty, and secure handling practices. Collaborate cross-functionally to align AI capabilities with regulatory standards. You’re excited about privacy, responsible AI, and building trustworthy technology. You are willing to relentlessly pursue the best, most responsible ways to leverage AI—without overselling its capabilities or ignoring its limitations. Must-Haves: 5+ years of professional software engineering or AI/ML experience Demonstrated experience building and running agentic systems in production with real users, not just prototypes or internal demos. Deep technical understanding of LLM usage and orchestration beyond prompt engineering. Proven experience building complex RAG systems and autonomous AI agents. Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Concrete examples of getting from ambiguity to results. Nice-to-Haves: Strong expertise in the Python AI ecosystem, including FastAPI and LangGraph. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest. We’re backed by top-tier investors including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans. We’ve also been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four years running, with 97% of employees saying Osano is a great place to work. As we grow, we're looking for individuals who lean into modern technologies and smarter systems to drive efficiency, clarity, and speed; both in our product and in how we operate. Weâre a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to liveÂ our values Â every day. Â How We Work We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. Own the agent work; support the whole product. Scope, build, ship, and maintain the agents including the evals that tell you whether they got better or are just different. This role is agent-focused and also includes some fullstack development. Build agents only Honeycomb can build. Use a data store that returns high-cardinality queries in seconds to reason over signal a conventional backend can't serve at this fidelity correlating across services, drilling into a single trace, comparing before and after a deploy. Extend the surface, and decide what's next. Ship new capability into Canvas, the MCP server, and Canvas Skills memory, spatial awareness, a faster Bedrock loop and make the case for what comes after with working code. Distinguish hype from signal in a field with plenty of both. Define what "good" means for agents here. Set the bar: measurable against real evals, maintainable, and honest about their limits. Example projects Multiple agents collaborating on one shared Canvas investigation each claiming a hypothesis, publishing findings, and narrowing the search space for the others so it resolves faster (blog). Auto-investigation the moment an SLO burn alert fires the agent forms hypotheses and prepares visualizations before a human looks, cutting mean-time-to-insight for on-call (o11ycon 2026). Skills that encode a team's domain expertise e.g. Kubernetes thresholds so agents and human colleagues can lean on them (o11ycon 2026). What you'll bring: AI and agent engineering experience. You've shipped LLM-based systems people relied on in production not demos, not fine-tuned models in a research context. You know where agent systems break and how to design around it. End-to-end ownership. On a small team there's no handoff queue. You can take something from rough prototype to production-grade without needing someone behind you to do the durable engineering. Agent architecture depth. You understand how a fast, high-cardinality data store changes what an agent can reason about, and how to design for that. Product judgment. You can look at what the agent layer does today and see what it should do next and make that case with a prototype, not a deck. Even better Observability or developer-tools background. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (R14369)
jobs.jd: Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to support our Marketing Data Science team and accelerate new member growth through predictive modeling and advanced analytics. You'll build prospect targeting and conversion prediction models that help Oportun identify promising prospective members, improve acquisition conversion rates, and reduce customer acquisition cost (CAC). You'll own models end to end—from feature development and validation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—in partnership with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You'll develop and deploy machine learning models for prospect targeting and conversion prediction to increase new member acquisition. You'll analyze internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing campaign and engagement data, third-party consumer and alternative data, and credit bureau data to build predictive features and identify growth opportunities. You'll apply statistical and machine learning methods, including logistic regression, gradient boosting, and related techniques, to improve targeting accuracy and conversion rates. You'll own reusable pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, scoring, deployment, and ongoing model monitoring. You'll partner with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering to translate model outputs into actionable acquisition strategies and reliable production workflows. You'll measure model effectiveness and business impact through new member acquisition, targeting accuracy, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, and production reliability. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You're a curious, rigorous data scientist who turns complex data into reliable models and practical business decisions. You enjoy ambiguous growth problems, take ownership of outcomes, and balance predictive performance with measurable acquisition impact. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 4+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, predictive modeling, or a related field. Strong Python and SQL skills and hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets. Experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as logistic regression and gradient boosting, to business problems. Experience developing, validating, deploying, and monitoring production machine learning models. Experience building reusable data preparation, feature engineering, and model scoring pipelines. Ability to assess model performance, data quality, and business outcomes and communicate clear recommendations. Strong cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and project ownership skills. Nice to Have Experience in marketing analytics, customer acquisition, prospect targeting, or conversion propensity modeling. Experience with internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing engagement data, third-party consumer or alternative data, or credit bureau data. Experience with AWS, SageMaker, EMR, Spark SQL, Hive, or similar cloud and large-scale data technologies. Experience in consumer lending, fintech, credit risk, or fraud risk. Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve modeling, coding, documentation, or research workflows. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. jobs.jd: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team Agent Factory is where Workday’s next chapter gets built. We’re forming small, senior, cross-functional AI teams that bring together product leaders, AI engineers, and full-stack builders to create intelligent agents used by millions of people every day. This is production-grade AI—deeply embedded into Workday’s platform—not research experiments or maintenance work. Teams own problems end to end, collaborate tightly across disciplines, and use the right tools to solve real customer challenges at global scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, platform architecture, and human workflows, with the autonomy to shape how agents reason, act, and scale responsibly. High trust, high expectations, and real impact. Engineering, but brighter. About the Role As an AI Engineer in Agent Factory, you’ll design and build the core ML systems behind Workday’s next generation of AI agents. Working within a small, senior, cross-functional pod, you’ll own how models, agent logic, and orchestration layers come together in production—across the full lifecycle from problem framing and data strategy to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. You’ll implement and evolve frameworks for LLM-powered agents, including RAG pipelines, workflow orchestration, evaluation, and feedback loops, ensuring solutions are scalable, observable, and enterprise-ready. This role sits at the intersection of ML and platform engineering: partnering closely with software engineers, product managers, and data scientists to integrate agents deeply into the Workday stack. You’ll stay hands-on with emerging techniques in agentic architectures while applying strong engineering judgment to turn them into systems that are reliable, explainable, and built to operate at global scale. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Foundations
jobs.jd:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Assistance Engineering team builds world-class tools for Airbnb's global network of support agents, so guests and hosts get a great experience 24/7, 365 days a year. Airbnb's operational staff must scale with our user base, and we own the entire tech stack behind their success.
Within Assistance Engineering, Assistance Foundations builds the shared platforms that support runs on: case management, the agent workspace, quality and coaching systems, money tooling, data services, agent routing, provisioning and training, and reliability. We are forming a dedicated Machine Learning Engineering group so that intelligence is built once on this foundation and reused across support, rather than rebuilt by each team. You will be one of its founding engineers.

Some of what we are building and shipping:

  • LLM-based quality evaluation that scores support cases against the quality standard, at scale
  • AI coaching that turns quality evidence into coaching plans for team leads
  • Simulation environments that train agents on realistic support scenarios
  • Natural language search and chat tools that help agents and supervisors find answers faster

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the LLM-based and agentic systems behind quality, coaching, case intelligence, and decision support for agents. The work spans prompt design, retrieval, fine-tuning, agent orchestration, dataset engineering, and evaluation. This is a product-building role: you will take systems from first experiment to production and own how they perform for real users.

A Typical Day: 

  • Design, build, and ship LLM-based and agentic systems, from technical design through implementation, experimentation, and deployment.
  • Build offline and online evaluation (human-labeled sets, LLM-as-judge, A/B tests) so that quality is measured, not assumed.
  • Curate and engineer the datasets that prompts, fine-tuned models, and evaluations depend on.
  • Turn one-off models and prompts into shared components that other Foundations teams can adopt.
  • Collaborate with product, design, engineering, data science, and support operations and quality teams to find high-impact problems and quantify results.
  • Participate in design and code reviews, and mentor other engineers.


Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of industry experience building and shipping applied machine learning, or a PhD in a related field plus 2+ years in industry
  • Recent, hands-on experience building LLM-based systems that shipped to production
  • Expertise in designing and iterating on prompts, fine-tuning, and LLM evaluation
  • Expertise in RAG patterns, memory, tool use, and agent planning
  • Experience integrating LLMs with APIs, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks
  • A solid foundation in machine learning: modeling, evaluation design, experimentation, and A/B testing
  • A track record of shipping AI products used by real users, not only research prototypes or offline models
  • Strong programming (Python, Java, or Kotlin) and the engineering skills to productionize your own work: model serving, monitoring, data pipelines, and safe deployment
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across teams and domains
  • Bachelor's and/or Master's/PhD degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

jobs.jd: Senior AI/ML Engineer, remote in Canada: own the AI that assesses patients for US healthcare providers and gets them to the right mental health care faster. About Limbic Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere. Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians. Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. The Role As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will take ownership of the AI in our clinical assessment product for US healthcare organizations. A patient describes what they are struggling with in a conversation with our AI, which gathers their history, administers standard clinical questionnaires such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, detects risk and recommends a treatment program for the organization’s clinicians to review. Every organization configures it for its own services, so the AI has to be safe and accurate across many clinical setups, not just one. The approach is proven at scale in the NHS, where it increased referrals from minority groups by 29%, as published in Nature Medicine. You will work in North American hours alongside product, engineering and clinical colleagues, in close collaboration with our ML team in London. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across Limbic. What You’ll Do Own the quality of the conversational AI that runs patient assessments, from each step of the conversation to clinical prediction and treatment recommendation. Improve the safety checks that screen every patient message and AI reply, covering risk, attempts to manipulate the AI, unsafe medical advice and clinically inappropriate responses, so they catch more problems without flagging good replies. Productionize ML models that optimize product KPIs, including the accuracy of clinical predictions and how quickly patients reach the right care. Build and maintain evaluation harnesses, simulated patient conversations and labelled transcript review, so every configuration can be tested before a patient sees it. Extend our assessment AI to new channels, including the phone, so that patients who cannot or will not use a web form still have a way in. Help turn our clinical AI into composable services that healthcare partners can integrate into their own patient journeys. Build agents and tooling that automate product development workflows, including reliable testing and customer demos. Raise the engineering bar through architecture, code review and mentorship, while keeping our AI continuously compliant with strict regulatory requirements. What You’ll Bring You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds: A PhD in computational science or an AI-related field, plus 2 years of experience in an ML engineering role. OR A BSc/MSc, plus 4 years of experience in an ML engineering role. Expertise in productizing LLM features and a strong background in eval-driven development. Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript. Proven experience building an LLM agent harness . Experience utilizing reinforcement learning. Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications. A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics. Proficiency with version control systems (preferably Git) and databases (SQL or NoSQL). Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerization technologies. A track record of end-to-end ownership: you scope work you can ship quickly, measure its impact, and keep a sense of urgency when the stakes are high. A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space. Ideal but not required: Experience with real-time voice AI, or with healthcare organizations as customers. North American business hours (Eastern time preferred), with daily overlap with colleagues in Europe (UTC to UTC+3). Based in Canada with the right to work there. jobs.jd: The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success. We expect Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands-off sellers and global brands with cross-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer-facing products with measurable business impact. This role combines science depth, product focus, and hands-on engineering: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across product and engineering partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems. Key job responsibilities As an Applied Scientist on this team you will: - Understand the pain points of Cross border advertisers as they scale across marketplaces, and build science-driven solutions that remove barriers and accelerate their growth and success. - Build agentic and ML systems that autonomously create, structure, and manage ad campaigns on advertisers' behalf, encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health. - Innovate on new, simpler ways to advertise powered by GenAI, and push the frontier of existing autonomous programs (e.g., auto-targeting, global lift-and-shift) while proposing and prototyping the next generation of campaign automation. - Develop models across the campaign lifecycle — opportunity discovery, ranking, ad-readiness and demand prediction, and bid/budget optimization — and apply the right approach for each problem, from classical ML to LLM/reasoning methods. - Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these systems — advertiser and campaign data, cross-marketplace performance, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance. - Own core parts of the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and model customization — and define evaluation and safety methodology so that automated decisions are reliable and trustworthy. - Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take systems from prototype to launch on large-scale pipelines (Spark/EMR, Airflow) and online serving. - Raise the science bar: review designs and experiment plans, and communicate results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and business leaders. About the team Autonomous SP drives growth and simplifies advertising for Amazon's hands-off advertisers by creating and enhancing autonomous campaign solutions.
